description.value: Sarah's Haida Arts and Jewellery is a gallery founded in 1975 by Claude Davidson and now operated by his widow Sarah Hillis, built in traditional Haida longhouse style in Old Massett on Haida Gwaii. The gallery exclusively features authentic works by local Haida artists — jewellery, argillite carvings, cedar weavings, prints, and clothing — making it one of the longest-running Indigenous art galleries on the island. Cyclists touring Haida Gwaii will find it a rare opportunity to purchase directly from a community-rooted gallery that has supported local artists for five decades.

address.value: 387 Eagle Ave, Old Massett, BC V0T 1M0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and provides clear contact details: 387 Eagle Ave, Old Massett, Haida Gwaii, phone 250-626-5560, corroborating the OSM URL. The about-us page notes the gallery is located in Sarah's home, built in Haida longhouse style, and has been operating since 1975. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or any cyclist-specific amenities anywhere on the site.
concerns: Gallery is located within Sarah Hillis's private home — visiting hours and access protocols are not stated on the website; cyclists should call ahead.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active, publicly accessible gallery and online shop with confirmed address and phone; a culturally significant stop for cyclists touring Haida Gwaii.
enrichment_extras.notes: Toll-free number also available: 1-888-626-5560. Email: sarahannehillis@gmail.com.

wow_evidence: Longhouse-style gallery founded 1975 by Chief Claude Davidson — among the longest-running Indigenous art galleries; authentic Haida work only.
blurb: Longhouse-style Haida art gallery in Old Massett, running since 1975.
